texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的地理构造的确是处在变动之中。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是地壳活动造成的。这一地壳活动虽然有趣但是却极其深奥。不过[Root.Owner.GetName]所感兴趣的，是某种可以停止星球这一无尽且无序的自我变构的方法。简单来说，使用此方法转化星球不仅用时极短，而且理论上也有可能让星球变得更加易于居住。

[Root.GetLeaderName]需要额外的200能量币进行地理活动勘测，以证明科学专员所提出的外科手术刀式精准改造方案是否真的可行。当然，如果以后想要使用现有的环境改造科技，也是可以的。
texts.en:
The very geological structure of [From.GetName] is indeed in flux, driven by what Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] assures us is a tectonic process as fascinating as it is esoteric. What is of more interest to the [Root.Owner.GetName] is that we may be able to strategically halt the planet's ceaseless, chaotic self-transformation. In short, a near-instant terraforming of the planet into something slightly - if not entirely - more habitable, is theoretically possible.

[Root.GetLeaderName] estimates that an additional 200 Energy Credits will be needed to power a thorough mapping of planetary activity and determine the validity of what the Science Officer has termed "a surgical terraforming strike." Of course, we can always choose to terraform it using existing technologies at a later date.

[Root.GetLeaderName]需要额外的200能量币进行地理活动勘测，以证明科学专员所提出的方案是否真的可以使用。目前我们还无法进行常规性的环境改造，所以这次真的是千载难逢的机会。
texts.en:
The very geological structure of [From.GetName] is indeed in flux, driven by what Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] assures us is a tectonic process as fascinating as it is esoteric. What is of more interest to the [Root.Owner.GetName] is that we may be able to strategically halt the planet's ceaseless, chaotic self-transformation. In short, a near-instant stabilization of the planet into something slightly - if not entirely - more habitable, is theoretically possible.

[Root.GetLeaderName] estimates that an additional 200 Energy Credits will be needed to power a thorough mapping of planetary activity and determine the validity of what the Science Officer has termed "a surgical terraforming strike." Actual terraforming lies beyond our grasp at present, so this is an exciting opportunity.

texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报说，[From.From.GetName]的确能够进行改造！在星球的自身转化进入时长几个月的不稳定阶段时，我们有一个非常短暂的时机。[Root.GetLeaderName]认为可以将小型炸药植入星球地壳中，再加上星球大气层的战略性辐照作用，便可以停止[From.From.GetName]永不停歇的自我转化过程，将其转变为更加易于居住的星球。

已经设立了特殊项目，但时间十分紧迫。
texts.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that [From.From.GetName] can indeed be terraformed! A narrow window of opportunity is expected to open shortly, as the planet enters a particularly unstable phase of its cycle lasting a couple of months. [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that miniaturized explosive charges delivered to the planet's crust and strategic irradiation of the atmosphere during this time will halt [From.From.GetName]'s tumultuous changes and stabilize it in a form somewhat more suitable for sustaining life.

A Special Project has been issued, but we do not have much time.
